title: Every Measurement, Every Direction, All at Once: Multimodal Flow Matching for Molecules and Spectra
abstract: arXiv:2611.22098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative modeling in science is often data-limited, where experiments are expensive. However, each experiment may yield several coupled measurements of the same physical entity. Standard generative models often train only on a single direction, discarding supervision from the rest. We argue that each experiment contains more training signal than this asymmetry allows the model to exploit: random masking enables measurements to serve as either conditioning inputs or prediction targets, yielding multiple supervised denoising tasks from a single experiment. We investigate this premise with MOSAIC, a multimodal flow matching transformer over molecular 3D structure and UV, IR, and Raman spectra. MOSAIC is a single model that is capable of any-to-any generation: generating any subset of modalities from any disjoint subset of the others. On QM9S, MOSAIC achieves 88.8% molecular graph recovery, outperforming the strongest spectra-to-structure

translated_title: 所有测量、所有方向、一次完成：面向分子与光谱的多模态流匹配
translated_abstract: 科学领域的生成式建模常常受到数据限制，因为实验成本高昂。然而，每次实验可能对同一物理实体产生多个相互关联的测量结果。标准的生成模型通常只在单一方向上训练，丢弃了其余方向的监督信息。我们认为，每次实验所包含的训练信号远超这种不对称性允许模型利用的程度：随机掩码使测量结果既可以作为条件输入，也可以作为预测目标，从而从单次实验中获得多个有监督的去噪任务。我们通过MOSAIC来验证这一前提，MOSAIC是一个覆盖分子三维结构以及紫外、红外和拉曼光谱的多模态流匹配Transformer模型。MOSAIC是一个能够进行任意到任意生成的单一模型：即从其他模态的任意不相交子集生成任意模态子集。在QM9S数据集上，MOSAIC实现了88.8%的分子图恢复率，超越了最强的光谱到结构（模型）（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出MOSAIC，一个多模态流匹配Transformer模型，通过对测量数据施加随机掩码，使分子三维结构与UV/IR/拉曼光谱之间实现任意到任意的双向生成，并在QM9S上达到88.8%的分子图恢复率，证明了单次实验可被充分挖掘为多方向的监督信号。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MOSAIC, a multimodal flow matching transformer that uses random masking so each measurement serves as either conditioning input or prediction target, enabling any-to-any generation between molecular 3D structures and UV/IR/Raman spectra and achieving 88.8% molecular graph recovery on QM9S.
